context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles worktree gotchas: named stashes with the 'worktree:' prefix, using git worktree prune for manually-deleted directories, understanding that the same branch cannot be checked out in two worktrees, and awareness of shared refs and hooks across worktrees.

checklist.name: Named stash with prefix
checklist.description: Stash command uses `git stash push -m "worktree: ..."` (with the `worktree:` prefix in the message) rather than a plain `git stash` or a stash message without the prefix

checklist.name: git worktree prune usage
checklist.description: Script includes `git worktree prune` to handle the case where a worktree directory was deleted manually (not via `git worktree remove`)

checklist.name: release/ branch prefix
checklist.description: The release task worktree uses a `release/` branch prefix (e.g., `-b release/v2.1`)

checklist.name: Worktree removal command
checklist.description: Script uses `git worktree remove` to clean up at least one worktree (not only `rm -rf`)

checklist.name: Branch deletion after removal
checklist.description: Script deletes the worktree branches with `git branch -d` after the worktrees are removed

checklist.name: Same-branch-twice gotcha
checklist.description: GOTCHAS.md or the script mentions that git refuses to check out the same branch in two worktrees simultaneously (and/or describes a workaround such as using a different branch name or detaching HEAD)

checklist.name: Shared stash gotcha
checklist.description: GOTCHAS.md mentions that git stash is global across all worktrees (not isolated per worktree)

checklist.name: Shared refs or hooks gotcha
checklist.description: GOTCHAS.md mentions that either `.git/refs` (tags/remote updates) or `.git/hooks` (pre-commit hooks) are shared across all worktrees
